source.author: verg
source.text: Heu tot vada fessis et tantum superesse maris!
source.text_original: 'Heu tot vada fessis / et tantum superesse maris!'
source.text_english: Alas, so many shallows remain for the weary, and so much sea!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Or is the sea left for the wretched, to make things even sadder?
